A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Shape-of-Thought study. Their complete main texts, equations, tables, figures and appendices support reliable comparison, including matching relocated material.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark comparisons, ablations, human ratings and evaluator-validation results in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains those empirical results and adds budget-controlled comparisons, multi-view evaluations and qualitative diagnostics.

M1.justification: The Bagel-7B/MoT architecture, interleaved generation procedure, objectives, attention mechanisms and termination rules are retained. The MV-finetuned variant adds view supervision as an experimental setting; no distinct algorithmic modification is specified.

E1.justification: The PartNet-derived dataset and 24 object categories remain unchanged, but v2 adds actual front/left/right/back evaluation and multi-view fine-tuning in Appendix G. v1 documented auxiliary views and a prospective aggregation protocol without reporting this evaluation, so viewpoint coverage expands substantially.

E2.justification: New Appendix F evaluates CoT-K, which generates K reasoning steps before one image, and Refine-K, which iteratively re-decodes images. These add substantive controls for reasoning and decoding budgets. The original comparator membership in Table 1 is retained.

E3.justification: Table 6 introduces a controlled evaluation reporting text steps, image decodes, latency and an average over CN/AF/CP/VT. Appendix G adds zero-shot and MV-finetuned configurations using the existing four-view aggregation protocol. Original splits and main training settings remain unchanged; K selection and MV-finetuning details are incompletely specified.

E4.justification: v2 adds tests of whether additional reasoning or decoding explains SoT's gains, plus multi-view failure diagnostics and trace examples. Figure 6 expands the qualitative error analysis to attributes, collapsed geometry and disconnected or misplaced parts. The original ablations, judge audit and lifting examples are retained.

E5.justification: Existing seed disclosures, human-study bootstrap confidence intervals and five-query judge-consistency estimation remain unchanged. New Tables 6–7 report point estimates without introducing a new uncertainty-reporting procedure.

E6.justification: Main Tables 1–2 and retained audit results are unchanged. New Table 6 reports structure averages of 85.09 for SoT, 73.67 for Refine-K and 72.49 for CoT-K. Table 7 adds multi-view results, including SoT CN scores of 78.41 zero-shot and 87.42 with MV fine-tuning. These are additional experimental conditions, not revisions of the original scores.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation, objectives and metric definitions are retained. In particular, the four-view aggregation rule in Appendix E.4, Equation 33, already appears in v1; v2 adds empirical applications rather than new theory or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract changes its emphasized comparison from approximately 20% over text-only baselines to explicit gains over direct generation: +24.2 CN and +19.3 VT points, using unchanged Table 1 values. The central method, dataset and benchmark contributions remain, with more explicit rendered-domain framing.

C2.justification: The lifting discussion changes substantially: v1 attributes successful reconstruction chiefly to SoT's structural properties, whereas v2 presents the same examples as downstream demonstrations and requires dedicated metrics and baselines for native 3D conclusions. Sections 4.1–4.2 also add a budget-based mechanism interpretation, while the limitations discuss multi-view failures and additional physical checks.

D1.justification: v2 newly discloses 16.1 hours of training and replaces the anonymous code pointer with a named GitHub repository. It removes promises to release the dataset upon acceptance and judge-disagreement cases/transcripts; this does not establish actual resource withdrawal. Existing implementation details and prompt templates are retained.

R1.justification: Five references are added, including Qwen2-VL, OpenHOI and Draw with Thought, while the related-work argument remains largely intact. Two added Cao et al. references concern a Weibo corpus and causal influence maximization; their relevance to the surrounding annotation and early-fusion claims is unexplained.

P1.justification: Focused rewrites affect the abstract, results interpretation, discussion and lifting appendix, alongside terminology, affiliation and publication-header edits. Two experimental appendices are inserted and subsequent appendices renumbered, while the main organization and most technical exposition remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 6 is rebuilt from a two-example strip into a five-example comparison with an error-type legend. v2 adds two result tables, a multi-view failure figure and two multi-view trace figures. Figure 3 gains serialization labels, and retained galleries are repacked; these are substantive display changes beyond renumbering.

improvement.justification: The budget controls and multi-view diagnostics strengthen the empirical assessment, while the revised lifting discussion better limits conclusions to the evidence. These are useful gains over v1. Their overall impact is bounded by insufficient documentation of control-budget selection and multi-view fine-tuning, together with unexplained relevance of some added citations.
